title: Active learning identifies experimentally improved ammonia catalysts
summary: Literature-trained models and iterative experimental feedback guided a predetermined ammonia-catalyst search. Selected formulations exceeded many reported comparator activities in the authors' laboratory measurements. Initial literature-only predictions were insufficient, making feedback essential. This is a bounded formulation result, not demonstrated commercial green-ammonia performance or invention of promoted ruthenium catalysis.
ai_technology: Active-learning regression trained on literature and experimental feedback

evidence.tested: Researchers synthesized and tested model-selected catalyst formulations and updated the model.
evidence.unknown: Independent formulation priority, replication and industrial performance were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Active-learning regression trained on literature and experimental feedback supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary publisher abstract, author affiliations and publication metadata; prior frozen method review retained, author manuscript freshly blocked.
